rules: Bots trade only versions with 30+ paper trades and a positive record; no trades with an idea whose paper record clearly loses for that class, or in a half hour where the ideas the bot can trade (not muted) clearly lose, from the dated record of earlier days (200+ trades, or 4+ days with a day z of −2 or lower, the scorecard's mute rule; the gates reopen when the record turns).
